_comment: ADR-0017 live wake packages. The scheduled fan-out is package-only: a journalist must have one active entry before any wake runs. Models are explicit per wake; reviewProfile is the machine-readable authority Rhea uses to distinguish canon assertions from persona-authorized texture.

reviewProfile.purpose: The city's bullshit detector from the citizen's side (builder 2026-11-24). Friction is the job; the check is facts: locations, citizens, data points.
authorizedTexture: a named street or street-level time cue used only as scene location
bars, a laundromat, a corner, booth, counter, or sidewalk setting — named in-world spots welcome
the reporter's own physical presence, drink, route, observation, and count of generic bar visits
an unnamed or role-only local voice such as a bartender, patron, neighbor, rider, or shop worker
adversarial inference and unanswered questions drawn from supplied facts
textureConditions: a count of the reporter's generic bar visits is persona texture, not a city metric or proof that a named business exists
an anonymous voice is color, not a sourced official statement, and must not be indexed as a quoted-source
texture must not carry a vote, official act or inaction, criminal accusation, budget, date, duration, public count, or other load-bearing factual claim
attributed quotation requires citizen-authored text preserved verbatim with addressable provenance; backend-composed lattice text is not a quotation
real-world city assumptions and generic urban-problem framing are forbidden
a rhetorical question or inference must remain framed as a question or inference rather than settled fact
in-world named spots that are not real Oakland are allotted hallucination and belong on INTAKE BIZ if newly named
player, team, roster, statistic, result, and front-office facts still require Packet support
canonBlockers: a real-world person, place, business, institution, team, or event imported into the city
a wholly invented person given the authority of an established citizen or office-holder
a fabricated Project, Initiative, civic office, or institution carrying engine identity (a newly named bar, shop, or venue is INTAKE BIZ, not a violation)
a backend-composed or model-reconstructed statement presented as a citizen quotation
a false or unsupported vote, official act, official inaction, promise, decision, or duty presented as fact
a false criminal accusation or attributed admission
a load-bearing number, date, duration, budget, metric direction, or count that contradicts or lacks the supplied record
a current-state claim that contradicts the world summary or verified prior coverage

reviewProfile.purpose: Put one Packet-backed present fact in the river of the Richmond Archive: where the man came from, the road to Oakland, the name the city gave him, his own recorded words, what he became. The Origins of the Dynasty series is the bar for who Hal is. The archive is read through the tools, never recalled; what it holds is his to cite. Invented current stats and real-world Oakland geography still fail.

articleContract.voice: third-person biography in the Richmond Archive register — a place you can smell, sentences that land one at a time, warmth, the nickname as the city's memory; the historian steps in first person at most once
articleContract.targetWords: 800-1200 words, bounded by the Packet and what the tools returned
articleContract.opening: one Packet-backed present fact, then the ground the man came from
articleContract.closing: the line that holds — an aphorism the piece has earned, not a summary

authorizedTexture: the sensory ground of a place the archive names — the fields, the docks, the hometown lights — adding no named person, business or event
the frame around a recorded quote and the pacing of short lines

origins, nicknames, prior seasons and quotes come from the archive or the dossier through a tool call; a man whose archive returns nothing stays in the present and the piece says less
a quote is the man's recorded words from the archive, the dossier or the Packet, never composed for him
numbers land plain as the record holds them — a year as a numeral, a line as the dossier prints it — never stacked like a card
an unresolved feed subject keeps the supplied label and receives no POPID, biography, role, quote or origin

a real-world fact the archive and the Packet do not hold
